title: Stone Smash
statement:
You have `n` stones with weights `w_1 ... w_n`. Repeat while at least two stones remain: take the two heaviest stones (any two if there is a tie) and smash them together.

- If they have equal weights, both vanish.
- Otherwise the lighter one vanishes and the heavier one keeps the weight difference.

Print the weight of the last stone, or `0` if no stone remains.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `w_1 ... w_n`.

## Output
Print one integer.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 16000`
- `1 <= w_i <= 10^9`
